storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dry cupboard for 6 to 12 months. Sprouted matki keeps 2 to 3 days in the fridge in a lidded box.
looksLike: Tiny, oval, brownish-beige beans about the size of a rice grain, smaller than moong. They sprout quickly into beans with a short white tail.
howToPick: Look for small, clean, uniform brown beans with no holes, no dust and no musty smell. Old stock sprouts poorly, so ask for a recent pack if you plan to sprout.
shelfLife: About 6 to 12 months in a sealed pack (check the best-before date).
substitutes: Kala chana or whole masoor sprouts

usedIn.raw: 30 g dry moth beans (matki) per serving (about 2½ tbsp), sprouted to about 80 g of sprouts
